sentences.text: It is contended on behalf of the accused-petitioner that no case for the alleged offences is made out against him and his incarceration is not warranted.
There are no factors at play in the case at hand that may work against grant of bail to the accused-petitioner and he has been made an accused based on conjectures and surmises.

3. Contrary to the submissions of learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Public Prosecutor opposes the bail application and submits that the present case is not fit for enlargement of accused on bail.
4. I have considered the submissions made by both the parties and have perused the material available on record as well as the challan papers.
5. The victim is a 30 years old married lady.
She alleges in the FIR that she was forcibly taken away by the petitioner and two-three other persons and she was taken to Jaipur and then to Jharkhand where she had been subjected to rape.
After investigation, the charge-sheet came to be submitted only against the petitioner.
The call data record analysis report dated 10.11.2023 reflecting that in between 04.04.2023 & 13.04.2023, as many as 188 times, the petitioner and the victim talked to each other.
On 11.04.2023, 21 times talking has been observed after scientific investigation.
The tower location of the victim has also been found to be some other place contrary to what she had alleged in the FIR and in her statement.

In view of the scientific investigation where the contents of FIR has been [2024:RJ-JD:2459] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-132/2024] bellied, it is deemed suitable to grant the benefit of bail to the petitioner in the present matter.

6. Accordingly, the instant bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner as named in the cause title shall be enlarged on bail provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.

(FARJAND ALI),J 90-Samvedana/-
